assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under reason code PR-204.
CPT 93247 represents long-term continuous ECG monitoring.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is coded as I48.0.
The patient has a significant history of transient ischemic attacks.
The transient ischemic attack history is coded as G45.9 and Z86.73.
A clinical indication note exists and is the source of the quoted clinical statements.
There is concern for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances.
The ordered study directly addresses the documented indication.
The appellant requests reconsideration of the coverage determination.
The denial was a coverage determination (service not covered under the benefit plan).
